census-conservation.test.mjs.census.mjs: reads a fixture client's qa reports under SGS_REPO_ROOT (a temporary folder) and the framework DB; its only browser use is the local draft server

fill-census.test.mjs.census.mjs: reads a fixture client's qa reports under SGS_REPO_ROOT (a temporary folder) and the framework DB; its only browser use is the local draft server

framework-backlog.test.mjs.framework-backlog.mjs: --sites names a temporary folder of gaps.json files; the command merges them into the backlog file and calls no site function

intake-command.test.mjs.intake.mjs: runs on a fixture draft export in the local replay sandbox (the draft's own recorded requests); no --site is given and the one provisioning dry run in lib/intake-siteinfo.mjs has no caller

intake-finalise.test.mjs.intake.mjs: runs on a fixture draft export in the local replay sandbox; no --site is given and the one provisioning dry run in lib/intake-siteinfo.mjs has no caller

manifest-build.test.mjs.manifest.mjs: reads a temporary client's handoff, page map and the framework DB and writes surfaces.json there; its import closure has no wp-cli, REST, session or browser call

sweep.test.mjs.sweep.mjs: reads and rewrites framework files named by the test; its import closure is three modules with no wp-cli, REST, session or browser call

wp-build-page.js.live: a live test on the canary (REST and a page build), skipped when the secrets file is absent or SGS_NO_SITE is set

wp-build-page-surface-shape.test.mjs.wp-build-page.js: the two-root footer tree is refused (exit 4) before any step reaches a site, and its env file names 127.0.0.1:1; the kill switch sits before the first browser step, so a missing refusal ends at SGS_NO_SITE instead of a login
